latest_release.body:
[![Download WinFsp](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Download%20WinFsp-blue.svg?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=grey&logo=data:image/svg%2bxml;base64,)](https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi) ## CHANGES SINCE WINFSP 2023 - [FIX] Fixes a compatibility problem with certain AntiVirus products (e.g. Trend Micro). - [FIX] Fixes a couple of rare BSODs on recent versions of Windows 11. See commits a482183, a2cd697 for details. - [FIX] Fixes a rare problem when using `NtCreateFile` to perform relative opens on a network drive (see GitHub issue #561). - [FIX] Fixes a racing issue with two processes competing to start the FSD discovered during testing.
